description:
Open jobs in Israel at every company we follow (700+, from startups to Intel and Teva), by role, city or remote, newest first, 50 a page. Each job has the company and a link to the posting on the company's own careers site, where people apply. Read daily from the companies' careers sites, so the openings are current.
Use when: the person is looking for a job in Israel or asks what is open: "find me DevOps jobs in Tel Aviv", "remote product manager jobs in Israel", "nursing jobs in Haifa", "English-speaking jobs in Jerusalem", "what jobs are there for a QA engineer?". Also for olim and anyone moving to Israel. Not for: one named company's openings, or which companies are hiring.
Input: `role` in the person's words (a role like "data scientist", or title words like "react developer"), or role slugs from `matched_roles` / `related_roles` comma separated ("full-stack-developer,backend-developer") to search exactly those roles; `city` in English ("Tel Aviv", "Petah Tikva"; nearby towns are included); `remote` true for remote jobs only; `page` from `next_page`. All optional; with none, the newest jobs in Israel.
Returns: `jobs[]` with `title`, `company` (`name`, `slug` for the company tools), `url` (the job on JustConnectUs), `apply_url` (the posting on the company's site), `locations`, `remote`, `work_arrangement`, `employment_type`, `roles`, `language` (en or he: the ad's language), `posted_at` and `summary` (the start of the ad; the full text is at `apply_url`); `matched_roles` (the job roles the words matched; jobs whose title has every word match too), `related_roles` (`name`, `slug`, `open_jobs` in all of Israel): roles close to the matched ones whose jobs are NOT in the results, e.g. Backend Developer for "full stack developer". Decide from the results whether to add them, or show them to the person and let them choose, then search again with the slugs. `city` (the city searched), `total`, `next_page`. An unknown city is an error with code `city_not_found`.

city.description: A city in Israel in English, e.g. "Tel Aviv", "Haifa", "Jerusalem", "Herzliya"

page.description: Page number, from `next_page` of the previous call (50 a page)

role.description: The job, in the person's words: a role ("DevOps Engineer", "product manager", "nurse") or words from job titles ("react developer"); or role slugs from `matched_roles` / `related_roles`, comma separated ("full-stack-developer,backend-developer")

name: search_jobs_in_israel
title: Search jobs in Israel
